slides.title: The first meeting is *all questions.*
slides.sub: No mood boards. No logo ideas. Just listening.

caption:
Clients are sometimes surprised by our first meeting. We don't bring logo ideas or slides. We bring questions.

Who are your best customers? Why did they choose you over someone cheaper? What do you wish people knew about your business?

The answers to those questions decide everything that follows: the words on your website, the look of your posts, even who your ads target.

If no one has ever asked you these questions about your brand, DM us. We'd love to.
